author: RedJay2013
body: Hey, I started playing Avicus about 2 years ago, however about a month or 2 after I started, I was banned by cinammoncroc000 for hacking (kill aura). However, I wasn't hacking and I have some friends who are currently enjoying your server, and now I would like to start playing your wonderful pvp server again and I hope you will allow this and lift my ban.

replies.author: Fouled
replies.body:
Hello,

Since you were banned quite a long time ago, I've decided to lift your infraction.
For future reference, please read through the rules.

Welcome back!

Regards,
Fouled
